name: SkyeMusicNexus Open Social Spine
purpose: Connect SkyeMusicNexus to open-source, federated social platforms without copying provider secrets into browser code.

integrationPolicy.tokenStorage: Provider OAuth access tokens are referenced by server environment variable name only.
integrationPolicy.gate: All social connector, queue, publish, feed-sync, and moderation actions require SkyGate or 0S proof session auth.
integrationPolicy.rightsBoundary: MusicNexus social posts can reference releases and media, but production publication still depends on release rights, media ownership, provider rules, and instance moderation policy.
integrationPolicy.licenseBoundary: This manifest records open-source platform integration targets. It does not vendor or relicense full upstream social platforms.

platforms.name: Pixelfed
platforms.role: Instagram-like photo/video feed for cover reveals, release images, reels/canvas teasers, and federated artist profiles.

platforms.name: Mastodon-compatible Fediverse
platforms.role: Public status, hashtag, release-note, and fan-update lane.

platforms.name: Funkwhale
platforms.role: Self-hosted audio publication and federated music pod lane.
platforms.musicNexusStatus: cataloged as production audio federation target; publishing stays staged until native API token mapping is configured.

platforms.name: ActivityPub Actor Bridge
platforms.role: Native inbox/outbox federation contract for future owned 0S actor identities.
platforms.musicNexusStatus: contract preview generated in queued posts; native federation requires actor documents, WebFinger, HTTP signatures, inbox/outbox storage, and moderation controls.
